links.outcome: Proportion of responses at college or higher reading level (Flesch-Kincaid)
links.effect: College or higher reading level: ChatGPT = 100%, Bard = 66%, UCF = 19%, p < 0.001; AI responses tended to require a higher reading level, possibly limiting applicability.
links.quote: However, AI-generated responses were more likely to be classified at an advanced reading level, while UCF responses showed improved readability (college or higher reading level: ChatGPT = 100%, Bard = 66%, and UCF = 19%), p < 0.001.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI patient education responses versus official materials
links.effect: ChatGPT 100% and Bard 66% of responses at college or higher reading level versus 19% for UCF materials (p < 0.001).
links.quote: However, AI-generated responses were more likely to be classified at an advanced reading level, while UCF responses showed improved readability (college or higher reading level: ChatGPT = 100%, Bard = 66%, and UCF = 19%), p < 0.001.
